name: Clockwork
abilities: Chronokinesis - slows, speeds up, freezes and reverses time
Time rays from hands/chest: age people or objects up or down, send targets to other times/timelines, freeze individuals
Retrocognitive holographic projections by winding his head key
Reversed a Chronosapien Time Bomb (No Watch Ben)
Enhanced strength and durability; keeps working with parts missing
Can be upgraded by a Galvanic Mechamorph (Techno-Bubble)
weaknesses: Powers useless where time does not exist (before the universe)
Aging rays do nothing to diamond/Petrosapiens
Disabled by large electromagnetic pulses (solar flares)
Every use ripples the timestream (Sotobro effect), detectable by other Chronosapiens
Bulky, slow, tires quickly, poor at dodging
Cannot travel between dimensions; can be magnetised
summary: A golden steampunk robot with a wind-up key who controls time itself - slowing foes, aging things away, or rewinding events - unlocked for Ben by Ben 10,000.
traits: 'Steampunk robot made by an insane watchmaker'
notableFeats: Disarmed Captain Nemesis with time rays (Catch a Falling Star)
Located the Flame Keepers' Circle by viewing the past (The Beginning of the End)
Helped fix the timestream and defeat Eon across both Ben bodies (Ben Again)
Beat a Squid Monster by slowing time (Bengeance is Mine)
Defeated Mad Diamondhead, Exo-Skull and Subdora with Techno-Bubble's upgrade (It's a Mad, Mad, Mad Ben World: Part 1)
No Watch Ben used him to reverse the Chronosapien Time Bomb (And Then There Was Ben)

appearances.designNotes: Golden metal body with black stripes, wind-up key on head, blank face, transparent green chest window showing gears; Ultimatrix symbol on chest. First on-screen use was by Gwen (Inspector 13); Ben's first is Catch a Falling Star.

notableEpisodes: It's a Mad, Mad, Mad Ben World: Part 1
It's a Mad, Mad, Mad Ben World: Part 2
appearances.designNotes: 16-year-old: larger body, holed key on a restructured head, back stripe splitting around a keyhole; Omnitrix on chest. 11-year-old Clockwork (Ben Again): thinner rounder head, smiley face, white/black shirt, round chest window, slightly different colours and gears; original Omnitrix on chest.

image.label: OV
image.notes: infobox OV render (16-year-old design; file redirects to Clocky.png)

scoring.rationale: Time manipulation is a fight-ending signature power (special 8, cosmic 7): slowing time to beat monsters, aging enemies, rewinding events and even undoing a Chronosapien Time Bomb. Slow, tires quickly, is a big target and gets knocked around by physical brawlers like Looma.

notes: Clockwork was unlocked in Ben 10,000 Returns and first transformed into by Gwen (Inspector 13); Ben's first on-screen use is Catch a Falling Star, which is used as debut. Ben also used him off-screen before Inspector 13 per the wiki.
OV usedBy includes ben-11-ov for Ben Again, where the 11-year-old body (with 16-year-old Ben's mind) became 11-year-old Clockwork; also used by No Watch Ben (And Then There Was Ben) - not counted.
Ultimate Ben used Clockwork's time rays in Ben 10,000 Returns (powers only).
UA wearer: Ultimatrix; OV: new Omnitrix (11-year-old version wore the original Omnitrix).
